claims.summary: Over every characteristic-five field in original cube dimension9, every optimal weighted transfer coefficient of the 48 boundary cofactors uses the unique input J=(0,1,2,3,5,6,7,8,10). The full output table and old-minor factors determine those coefficients. After dividing by V_10^10, the nonzero vector of coefficients at U_c-90 is still divisible by e1*e5-e6 in the eight old roots. The last two raw leading coefficients agree at degrees330 and331. This refutes primitivity of the optimal-layer vector, not primitivity of the full cofactors.
